# Markham HVAC Pros

> Markham HVAC Pros provides heating and cooling service to homeowners in and around Markham, York Region, Ontario. The team handles furnace and AC repair, ductless mini-split installation, heat pump service, gas fireplace work, thermostat upgrades, and duct cleaning.

Phone: (905) 472-8537  |  Email: contact@markhamhvacpros.ca  |  Website: https://markhamhvacpros.ca

Service areas: Markham, Richmond Hill, Newmarket, Aurora, Vaughan, Keswick, Stouffville, King City
